messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: INC-4567 fired for service=model-serving-ml-prod — high 5xx/error-rate > 5% over 3m. Priority: P1. Trigger: 5xx_ratio > 0.05. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-4567

pagerduty: Notification: Primary on-call (alice) paged (SMS/push). Escalation policy: model-serving-prod -> secondary -> manager.

alice: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling metrics and checking recent deploys.

bob: I can jump in if needed — just finishing a deploy but available.

charlie: Noting customer impact: support flagged 3 customers reporting 504s since 14:02 UTC.

alice: quick heads-up: errors spike started ~14:00 UTC, looks correlated with model v2.3 rollout to canary pool. Running runbook: model-serving/high-error-rate.

eng-sre-lead: If this is rollout-related, we should roll back the canary and pause deploys. Also check autoscaler behavior (timeouts?).

alice: running queries now. Getting slow responses from triton-gpu-03.  tail'ing logs: ```
2026-03-14T14:01:58Z model-serving-ml-prod triton-gpu-03 ERROR: inference failed: kv-cache OOM
2026-03-14T14:02:05Z model-serving-ml-prod triton-gpu-02 WARN: increased latency to 1.2s
```

alice: Attempting to drain canary and set model rollout to 0% for v2.3. Command: `./ctl rollout pause model-serving-ml-prod --model v2.3`

dana: I don't see an automated rollback triggered — manual rollback seems safest. I can execute if you want.

alice: Please do manual rollback to v2.2 on canaries, then scale up v2.2 replicas to handle traffic.

pagerduty: Escalation: Primary did not acknowledge within 2m window earlier -> secondary (bob) paged. Secondary acknowledged at 14:05 UTC. Manager escalation not fired.

bob: Acked (taking over). Running rollback now. `./ctl model deploy --service model-serving-ml-prod --model v2.2 --scale 6`

charlie: Noting that traffic shifted to other replicas but some requests still 504 for a subset of customer traffic — possibly sticky sessions to triton-gpu-03.

bob: Running drain on triton-gpu-03: `kubectl cordon triton-gpu-03 && kubectl drain triton-gpu-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`

alice: I'm updating customers in support thread — short message: "We're investigating increased error rates, mitigation in progress, estimate 15-30m" :hourglass: 

dana: After rollback and drain, error rate dropped to ~0.8% at 14:12 UTC. Monitoring.

eng-sre-lead: Good. Can we capture root cause post-handoff? Looks like kv-cache OOM on GPU node while v2.3 increased memory use. Add to postmortem if confirmed.

alice: Agreed. I'll add runbook steps we followed and note that rollout should include memory regression checks.

pagerduty: Incident status update: Resolved (alerts recovered below thresholds) at 14:13 UTC. Incident auto-close will happen in 30m unless reopened.

charlie: Customer impact summary for postmortem: 3 customers saw intermittent 504s for ~10-12m window, no data loss, functionality degraded.\nAction items: 1) Add pre-rollout memory regression test for model variants; 2) Improve autoscaler sensitivity for OOM patterns; 3) Add a circuit-breaker to prevent sticky routing to nodes hitting OOM.

bob: Handing back to alice for follow-ups and postmortem, I'm going offline for the deploy wrap-up.

alice: Thanks all. I'll do the postmortem draft and tag owners for the action items.

eng-sre-lead: Also add a PagerDuty tweak: shorten primary ack window for this escalation path and notify managers if secondary doesn't ack within 5m.

incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty incident INC-4567 closed by bob at 1767001589. Runbook steps logged to /runbooks/model-serving/high-error-rate.

alice: closing thread — will share postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
